courses.title: Psychic Protection with Archangel Michael
courses.description: A guided meditation download that calls on Archangel Michael to clear heavy or fearful energy and surround you with protection. It can also be played to clear the feel of a room.

courses.title: 5 Minute Meditation for Energy Cleansing with Archangel Michael
courses.description: A short daily guided practice using aura combing with Archangel Michael to release cords and stuck energy when you feel drained, worried or stressed. Also usable as a space clearing.

courses.title: Healing with Jesus
courses.description: A guided meditation journey with Jesus as a loving teacher, centred on forgiveness, love and seeing your life as an expression of God's love.

courses.title: Guided Meditation for Deep, Healing Sleep with the Angels
courses.description: A bedtime guided meditation that invites the angels' presence as you drift into rest, set over music tuned to 432 Hz and 528 Hz. Meant to make sleep a restful, soulful time.

courses.title: Guided Angel Meditation for Pregnancy
courses.description: A guided meditation for those who are pregnant, hoping to be, or supporting a partner, focused on bonding with the soul of the coming child and receiving the angels' support while preparing for parenthood.
